description: Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue is an open data portal listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Board of the Geographic Information Infrastructure of Spain (CODIIGE) for managing and controlling Spanish SDI (IDEE). Official Catalogue of Inspire Data and Services (CODSI) provides access INSPIRE data sets, HVD and network services. This catalogue is connected via harvesting or file interchange with the catalogues of national and regional public organisations, is the base for the monitoring process and for feeding the INSPIRE Geoportal. Coverage: Spain. The European data portal lists 942 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 77 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 18 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
